metadata.case_title: भैयालाल श्याम बेहारी vs कर आयकर आयुक्त
metadata.summary: The case involved a reference under Section 256(1) of the Income-tax Act, 1961 regarding additions towards unexplained deposits. The Tribunal rejected the plea that only peak credit should be added if deposits are treated as unexplained. The Court held that the applicant must establish the source of deposits before claiming peak credit. As the cash credits were in the names of different persons claimed to be genuine, withdrawals to different persons in previous years did not entitle the applicant to peak credit. The Court found no legal infirmity in the Tribunal's order, answering the questions in favor of the Revenue.
